abstracted later. This packet does not itself instantiate the callee joins.

Both full typed statement variants and all field bit patterns, arbitrary encoded688-byte candidate and all1769 output bytes; returned child length0..1769. Assertions are accepted-only; broader rejected buffer/SDK effects are checked by the separate heap/lifecycle certificates.

native std-any GOTO function may be overapproximated only with explicit symbol/tool pins; reference scan false requires native-accepted scan/byte-view composition

allocation/SDK/compiler/runtime P2/P6 boundaries; no whole source or global join completion from codegen or this context alone
